critique: The luminous cellular sphere is an unmistakable primary focal point and the right control panel forms a coherent secondary column. The screen title in the upper left is comparatively small and detached from the sphere, while the three metrics along the bottom left are also detached from both the title and the visualization; this creates three separate information islands around an otherwise strong centerpiece. Inside the panel, the oversized generation number dominates more than the running state or the two sliders, although the sliders are the more likely adjustable controls.
suggestion: Bind the visualization information into one region by aligning the title directly above the sphere and grouping active cells, surface density, and topology in a compact caption immediately below it. Preserve the sphere's dominance. In the control panel, reduce the generation number slightly, clarify the hierarchy between live status, adjustable parameters, chromatic legend, and actions, and add stronger vertical grouping between each slider label/value and its control. Keep Pause Evolution as the primary action and Reseed visibly secondary.
audit_note: Produced by an isolated Clarity & Information Hierarchy critic using only the task brief and the shared r0 screenshot; no generation notes, other critic outputs, revisions, or scores were inspected.
